user.title: HVAC Horizon
user.description: Pick the AC, its power sensor, the room and outdoor temperature sensors. Price, humidity and energy are optional.

data.climate_2: Second AC in the same room (optional)
data.power_2: Second AC power sensor, W (optional, enables the two-device fit)
data.room_humidity: Room humidity sensor, e.g. the bedroom monitor (optional)
data.presence: Presence sources: any home means home, all away for the away delay means away (optional)
data.window_delay_min: Minutes a window may stay open before the AC pauses
data.window_azimuth: Window facing direction, degrees from north (optional)
data.control: Let HVAC Horizon control the AC (off = observe only)
data.heater_inverted: Heater switch is inverted (on means off)
data.ai_conversation: AI conversation agent for the investigator (optional)
data.ai_budget_per_day: Model calls per day for the investigator (0 or empty is off)
data.comfort_energy_weight: Comfort to eco weight, 0 to 1 (optional, 0 is off)
data.trv_temperature: TRV own temperature sensor (optional, needs a valve). Each 1 K of offset moves the valve opening by 100 percentage points, clamped to 0 to 100 (1 K valve band).
data.shed_loads: Loads to shed, as entity_id|watts, lowest priority first (optional)
data.window_area_m2: Window area, m² (optional, needed for solar gain)
data.irradiance: Irradiance sensor on the window, W/m² (optional)
data.vacation: Vacation switch, on means vacation mode (optional)
data.radiators: Heater is radiators or underfloor heat (residual heat after it stops)
data.coil_dry: Dry the AC coil after cooling
data.house_sealed: House is sealed (never run the whole-house fan)
data.away_delay_min: Minutes without presence before away mode
data.schedule_blocks: Schedule blocks: a list of {start_h, end_h, preset}, hours 0 to 24, preset comfort, eco, boost or away (optional)

abort.already_configured: This AC is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings updated. Stored samples are kept.

error.invalid_schedule_blocks: Schedule blocks must be a list of {start_h, end_h, preset}. Hours run from 0 to 24 and start_h must differ from end_h. Presets: comfort, eco, boost, away.

sensors_stalled.title: HVAC Horizon sensors not updating
sensors_stalled.description: These sensors have not updated recently: {sensors}. Control uses the last good readings until they recover.

heating_failure.title: HVAC Horizon heater is not warming the room
heating_failure.description: The heater has been on for 60 minutes and the room has risen less than 0.5 °C. Check the heater and its switch.

mode_mismatch.title: HVAC Horizon mode does not match
mode_mismatch.description: The AC is in a different mode than HVAC Horizon last set. Check whether it was changed on the unit or another automation.
